name: WebToffee Inventory Sync for Amazon
author: WebToffee

sections.description:
Note: This is an early release. Some features aren’t live, so functionality is limited for now. We’ll be rolling them out soon in upcoming updates.

The WebToffee Inventory Sync for Amazon plugin makes multichannel selling effortless by connecting your WooCommerce store to Amazon. It keeps your inventory and prices perfectly aligned across platforms with real-time syncing, so you can avoid overselling, mismatched prices, and unhappy customers.

Publishing products on Amazon is quick and hassle-free. Push items directly from WooCommerce in bulk or fine-tune your selection with powerful filters by category, tags, price, or stock. ASINs (Amazon Standard Identification Number) are automatically assigned, and predefined templates handle repetitive details like category or fulfillment method, making your listings faster, cleaner, and error-free.

Stay in control with flexible, channel-specific rules for pricing, stock sync, and listing preferences. And with a unified dashboard, you’ll see everything at a glance such as stock changes, low-stock alerts, and product updates.

Simple, reliable, and built for growth, this plugin saves time, reduces errors, and helps you reach millions of Amazon shoppers.

External Services

This plugin uses WebToffee services for inventory sync and secure authentication.
WebToffee Multichannel API Service
– Syncs products, inventory, and store settings between WooCommerce and Amazon.
– Data sent: Store details, inventory, pricing, and auth tokens.
– When: During setup, sync, and token refresh.
WebToffee Token Management Service
– Handles secure token generation and refresh.
– Data sent: Encrypted tokens and site identifiers.
– When:During token creation and refresh.

All data is encrypted before transmission. No personal customer data is shared.
Terms|Privacy

Key Features

🔸 Automatic Real-time Inventory Sync – Whenever a product sells on WooCommerce or Amazon, stock levels are updated instantly across both platforms to prevent overselling.
🔸 Bulk Product Publishing – Publish WooCommerce products to Amazon in a few clicks. Upload in bulk or choose specific items, with built-in ASIN assignment using GTIN/UPC codes to meet Amazon’s requirements.
🔸 Advanced Product Filters – Select which products to list with filters for category, stock status, tags, and price range. Quickly launch seasonal collections, promote high-stock items, or exclude out-of-stock products.
🔸 Predefined Listing Templates – Save time and eliminate repetitive data entry with pre-set templates for categories, conditions, fulfillment methods, and other marketplace attributes.
🔸 Flexible Channel Preferences – Manage channel-specific settings directly from WooCommerce. Adjust inventory sync behavior, set listing visibility, and configure fulfillment methods for Amazon.
🔸 Smart Pricing Rules – Apply automatic markups or discounts per channel with fixed or percentage-based rules. Stay competitive by tailoring pricing to Amazon’s fees, audience, or market trends.
🔸 Unified Dashboard – Track your entire multichannel operation in one place. Monitor stock changes, listing updates, and low-stock alerts in real-time without switching platforms.

Why Choose WebToffee Inventory Sync for Amazon Plugin?

WebToffee develops high-quality WordPress and WooCommerce plugins that are simple, reliable, and easy to customize. Trusted by millions of customers worldwide, we’ve built and maintained 40+ plugins that power stores of all sizes with proven performance and flexibility. Backed by a 4.8/5 Trustpilot rating and 99% customer satisfaction score, we focus on usability, scalability, and support to help businesses streamline operations, reduce complexity, and grow faster.

☂️ RELATED PLUGINS FROM WEBTOFFEE

Other useful plugins from WebToffee:

🔸 WooCommerce Product Import Export Plugin: Easily import and export products to/from your WooCommerce store using a CSV file.
🔸 Order/Coupon Import-Export for WooCommerce: Import and export orders and/or coupons from your WooCommerce store using CSV with the plugin.
🔸 WordPress Backup & Migration: Quickly migrate and backup entire WordPress site or selected files from one location to another. Backup to FTP, Google drive, Amazon S3, or local storage and easily restore them back.
🔸 WebToffee WooCommerce Product Feed & Sync Manager: Generate WooCommerce product feed for Google and Facebook shops and sync WooCommerce products with Facebook catalog.
🔸 GDPR Cookie Consent: This plugin helps websites comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations by displaying a customizable cookie consent banner. Manage cookie categories, log consents, and implement prior consent for cookies.

Plugin Updates

For every update of the plugin, you will be notified of the installed plugins page. You can directly update the plugin from your dashboard. We recommend that you keep the latest version of the plugin so that you can avail of the new functionalities and security features.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP Version: 7.0
  • WordPress version: 6.2
  • WooCommerce version: 4.0

Steps to Install the Plugin

To install the plugin, follow the below steps:

Step 1: Log in to your WordPress dashboard.
Step 2: Navigate to Plugins and select Add New.
Step 3: From the search box, type “WebToffee Inventory Sync for Amazon” and click Search Plugins.
Step 4: Once you find the WebToffee Inventory Sync for Amazon plugin by WebToffee, click on Install Now.
Step 5: After installation, click Activate to activate the plugin.

You can also install the plugin by downloading the zip file from the plugin page on WordPress.org. Then upload the file directly from your WordPress dashboard, or using an FTP application.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support all Amazon marketplaces?

Yes, it works with major Amazon marketplaces including the US, UK, Canada, Germany, and more.

Can I sync prices as well as inventory?

Yes. The plugin syncs inventory in real time and allows you to apply flexible pricing rules such as markups or discounts for Amazon.

How often does syncing happen?

Inventory and pricing are updated in real time whenever there’s a change in WooCommerce or Amazon.

Does the plugin support bulk product upload?

Yes. You can publish multiple products at once from WooCommerce to Amazon, with ASINs automatically assigned where applicable.

Does the plugin support variable products?

Yes. Variations (like size and color) can be mapped and synced with their corresponding listings on Amazon.

Can I apply different prices on WooCommerce and Amazon?

Yes. With channel-specific pricing rules, you can apply fixed or percentage-based markups and discounts for Amazon.

Will my custom product attributes transfer to Amazon?

Yes, you can use predefined templates to ensure Amazon listings include all required attributes such as category, condition, and fulfillment method.

Will existing customers on WooCommerce be affected?

No. The plugin only manages product listings and inventory sync. Your existing customer data remains unaffected.

Is there a dashboard to track everything?

Yes. A unified dashboard gives you real-time insights into stock levels, product changes, listing updates, and low-stock alerts.
